failures.issue: Official sample PDF preferred even when entityBound=true — reference sample can replace live transaction data for HAWB
failures.recommendedCorrection: Skip CDN sample when entityBound; use template-v2 or pack with live mapped fields

failures.issue: 3 original/pre-printed codes still suggest *_draft packs (FG_HBL_ORIGINAL_FORMAT_87, HAWB_ORIGINAL_PRE_PRINTED_*)
failures.recommendedCorrection: Update suggestedPackKey to sea.hbl_original / air.hawb_final (FE refine already prefers live original/final when exposed)

failures.issue: templateTypeFor does not handle purchase_invoice (falls through to other.*); InvoiceTemplateDocument purchase mode is color/subtitle only
failures.recommendedCorrection: Return invoice.purchase for purchase_invoice; keep structural distinctness as follow-up (not a rewrite)

failures.issue: deliveryInstructions mapped from data.commodity — misuses cargo commodity as delivery instructions
failures.recommendedCorrection: Leave deliveryInstructions undefined unless a real API field exists; do not invent

failures.issue: openingBalance/closingBalance inferred from table cell heuristics; resolveCatalogContextPdfData has no debit/credit/opening/closing fields
failures.recommendedCorrection: Only display balances when API provides them; otherwise show N/A when entityBound — do not invent running balance math on FE

failures.issue: discount hardcoded to 0; VAT may be recomputed from vatRate when tax missing — can diverge from backend totals
failures.recommendedCorrection: Pass through backend discount/tax/total only; never recompute tax when entityBound without backend tax

failures.issue: mawb family renders HawbTemplateDocument — MAWB not visually distinct from HAWB
failures.recommendedCorrection: Add MawbTemplateDocument or explicit MAWB chrome variant (follow-up; not Phase-6 rewrite)

failures.issue: Template-v2 quotation/purchase/voucher share commercial invoice ChargesTable DNA (title/color differences only for purchase)
failures.recommendedCorrection: Tracked as known visual debt; do not mass-rewrite in Phase 6 — prioritize DO/manifest/HAWB sample path which are distinct

summary.productionReadyReason: Critical: HAWB entity-bound generate can emit CDN sample instead of live data; financial mappings incomplete for discount/balances; arrival Format-11+ false coverage without alias
